title: Most U.S. senators appointed since 1990 have run to keep their seat – and most have won
summary_en: The U.S. Senate has had 43 appointed members since 1990, and 27 of them (63%) have run to keep their seat.

title: How confident are Americans in the midterm elections’ fairness and accuracy?
summary_en: Just over half of Americans are confident the 2026 midterms will be fair.

title: What do Americans think about language learning in U.S. schools?
summary_en: Four-in-ten Americans say it is extremely or very important for children growing up in the U.S. to learn a language other than English.
title_cn: What do Americans think about language learning in U.S. schools?
